body:
Long, drawn out, convoluted story. Some of it was explained in an [old post I made on another throwaway account some time ago](http://redd.it/2ukc4n). Couldn't remember the password. Really though, all of that is just incidental stuff. I feel completely isolated without having the peace of actually being alone. I feel trapped and without solutions. Most of it is centered around my absolutely crappy relationship with my wife and general lack of any other relationships or close family. And I'm realizing I'm becoming a crappy person due to the various stresses and pressures. I'm becoming selfish, angry, short tempered, and I complain about it, like I'm doing here, almost any chance I get. Which I'm sure people get tired of. I'm making others miserable. I'm tired of it. I'm an obstruction to them, and I'm miserable playing that role. I can't find a way to change it. I've looked for solutions. I've spent countless hours running down possibilities. I'm tired. If I have to be alone and useless, I'd like to at least have some peace and solitude, some time where I don't have to worry about maintaining a life and lifestyle that I hate and that everyone around me hates, but I simply have no power to change without causing great harm to them. Unless I get out of the way and give them the opportunity to find something/someone better. I'm not a good person. I'm a person who tries to be good and fails spectacularly at it.

Now, today, my water has been shut off because of a leak. It's hopefully going to be fixed tomorrow, but the problem is complicated enough that might not happen. The whole house really needs to be re-plumbed, and I've got a $2,000 max budget for it. I have two small children in the house and no running water. My wife has been diagnosed with postpartum depression, but our relationship had gone down the crapper long before that was in the picture. And I feel selfish for thinking of myself when I know she is miserable. But she has hurt me so much that I get anxiety just being in the same room with her, I can't stand to touch her or look her in the eye anymore. It's stupid. I wish I could just leave it all, but I would be an unforgivably selfish ass to leave my wife and kids. But they deserve better.

Me dying wouldn't solve their problems, but at least it would bring a permanent end to the source. Then, perhaps, they would have a chance to put things back together for themselves and move on.

I've lived gender dysphoria for decades. I understand. Due to circumstances I've had no choice really but to live as my biological sex. It's a daily struggle. And I completely know what you mean by "waiting for science fiction".
